encoding: One bit per triangle occurrence; three bits at each original vertex, q=8. sigma_t is XOR of its triangle bits. H(X_v|X_N(v))=0 uses the full original neighborhood. Local smaller-set FDs come ONLY from actual XOR component inversion after conditioning fixed-factor tuples; never from an abstract graph FD.

vector_format.JSONL: One complete certificate per line; arrays rows are literal, not ellipsized. Source original bytes are also included.
vector_format.row: name is the semantic row descriptor, relation ge/eq/le describes its unweighted entropy vector, multiplier is an exact rational string. image_vectors[g] is the complete sparse integer coefficient vector for action g, coordinate 0 omitted because H(empty)=0. The linear combination is sum_rows multiplier/action_count * sum_g image_vector[g].
vector_format.targets: Functional identities use target 3*Delta <=0 on 5119 branch coordinates. All other Delta certificates use Delta <=0 on 2047 entropy masks. Proper D2/D3 use scale*(2sum Hsingle-3Hjoint)>=0 on the source active-vertex order, 511 masks. Positive coefficient on a ge row is required for the proper target; negative for Delta targets; le rows have positive coefficients for Delta. Equalities have unrestricted signed multipliers.
vector_format.functional_coordinates: id=5*A+b. A is original vertex-subset bitmask. b=0:no auxiliary; b=1:full S=(A_bit,B_bit); b=2:A_bit; b=3:B_bit; b=4:A_bit XOR B_bit. S is NOT one independent binary bit. Each branch is an ordinary eleven-variable entropy vector. Each distinct pair of nonzero forms determines S. Vertex/color actions are provided explicitly.
vector_format.n11_coordinates: id is the entropy bitmask on Y1,...,Y10,S, with bit10 representing full S.
vector_format.coverage: Every plane row gives all three nonzero 10-bit directions, J=their union, W=vertices where their incident projection is injective, and a specific argument/certificate. client_to_certificate_action acts on the target law; certificate_to_client_action transports the source proof to the target law. Action tables contain every literal permutation. Class IDs are zero-based positions of the supplied canonical coloring list, bound to the actual certificate coloring, never just its historical numeric label.
